free_tier.stated: Free: 25 GB total asset storage, 2 GB per shop item. Standard/Gold: 200 GB total, 5 GB per item.

chaining: 25 GB free total is a fixed bucket, so it does not scale by sharding accounts cheaply (each needs a separate email + PayPal/Stripe). 200 GB on a paid tier is real but small.
limits_note: per-account-cap (not per-object): 25 GB free / 200 GB paid. per-object 2 GB / 5 GB.
reliability_note: Third-party summaries disagree wildly on the free per-file number (100 MB vs 2 GB vs 10 MB) — the help-centre figure quoted here is the vendor's own.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Free users get up to 25GB of Ko-fi Shop asset storage. Standard users (previously called Contributors) get up to 200GB'; 'Free users can upload up to 2GB of files per shop item. Standard users ... up to 5GB per shop item'

notes: Free: 25 GB total asset storage, 2 GB per shop item. Standard/Gold: 200 GB total, 5 GB per item.

dead_end.why: Free: 25 GB total asset storage, 2 GB per shop item. Standard/Gold: 200 GB total, 5 GB per item.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
